title: Transport of the normalized localization equation along a representative isomorphism
statement: Given two cochain complexes P and Q and an isomorphism between their derived images, an equality of the normalized quotient section computation maps at P transports to the corresponding equality at Q.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; naturality and cancellation in the resolving-class localization descent.

proof_origin.place: Naturality and cancellation along the representative isomorphism.

proof.text: Package the two displayed composites as natural transformations in the derived object. Naturality along the supplied isomorphism identifies their components at Q with the components at P; substitute the assumed equality at P and cancel the source isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem section_pull_normalized_localization_transport_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y) (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T) (e : cY.model.E ⋙ pullback Λ' f ≅ pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E) (P Q : CochainComplex (modules Λ Y) ℤ) (i : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (h : barLam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ cX.model.T.map ((pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫ cX.model.ε.app (((pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) = (derivedPullback Λ' f).map (cY.model.ε.app P) ≫ (pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((cY.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso e (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)) : barLam.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫ cX.model.T.map ((pullback Λ f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q) ≫ cX.model.ε.app (((pullback Λ f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (pullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.E)) (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q) = (derivedPullback Λ' f).map (cY.model.ε.app Q) ≫ (pullback Λ' f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((cY.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso e (.up ℤ)).hom.app Q)
